scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:native && npm run copy:native
scripts.copy:native: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = 'build/Release/litert-node-bindings.node'; const dest = '../../apps/desktop/resources/native/win32-x64/litert-node-bindings.node'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); console.log('Copied native bindings to desktop resources.'); }"
